description: Discover famous landmarks, historic sites, and cultural wonders from around the globe.

questions.prompt: Which city is home to this Tower?
questions.fact: The Eiffel Tower shown here is a half-scale replica at the Paris Las Vegas Hotel and Casino.

questions.prompt: In which city can you find this skyscraper?
questions.fact: The Shard is a distinctive glass skyscraper near London Bridge in central London.

questions.prompt: In which country is the ancient pyramid located?
questions.fact: Chichén Itzá is a Maya archaeological site on Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula.

questions.prompt: Which city is home to this reflective sculpture shown in this image?
questions.fact: Cloud Gate, popularly known as 'The Bean,' stands in Millennium Park in Chicago.

questions.prompt: In which country can you visit the prehistoric stone circle?
questions.fact: Stonehenge is a prehistoric monument on Salisbury Plain in England, part of the United Kingdom.

questions.prompt: Which city is pictured beneath the Christ the Redeemer statue?
questions.fact: Christ the Redeemer overlooks Rio de Janeiro from the summit of Mount Corcovado.

questions.prompt: In which city is the ancient Colosseum shown in this image?
questions.fact: The Colosseum is an ancient amphitheater in the center of Rome, Italy.

questions.prompt: Which city is home to this bridge?
questions.fact: The Brooklyn Bridge connects Manhattan and Brooklyn across the East River in New York City.

questions.prompt: In which country are the Moai statues shown in this image located?
questions.fact: The Moai statues stand on Rapa Nui, also known as Easter Island, which is part of Chile.

questions.prompt: Which city is home to the Sagrada Família shown in this image?
questions.fact: The Sagrada Família is Antoni Gaudí's famous unfinished basilica in Barcelona, Spain.

questions.prompt: Which city is home to the Half House shown in this image?
questions.fact: Toronto's Half House is the surviving portion of an 1890s row house in the city's downtown area.
